"""
LRU Cache with TTL Expiry – Implementation & Test Suite

This module provides a thread-safe LRU (Least Recently Used) cache that also
enforces a Time-To-Live (TTL) policy. Entries expire automatically after a
configured duration. A wrapper class is provided to simplify usage and expose a
clean API.

Design Highlights
------------------
* LRU Eviction: The cache uses an OrderedDict internally to achieve O(1) eviction
  of the least recently accessed item.
* TTL Support: Each cached value is stored together with an absolute expiry
  timestamp. On every access (get / set) the item is "touched" and refreshed
  (if it is still within its TTL window).
* Thread Safety: All public methods are protected by a threading.Lock so that
  concurrent reads and writes never corrupt the internal structures.
* Pytest Suite: A comprehensive test suite is included to verify:
    * Basic get/set behaviour.
    * LRU eviction order.
    * TTL expiry behaviour (both automatic and explicit).
    * Thread safety under concurrent stress.
    * Edge cases (empty cache, duplicate keys, etc.).
"""

"""
LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) Expiry

This module provides a thread-safe implementation of a Least Recently
Accessed (LRU) cache that automatically expires entries after a
configurable Time-To-Live (TTL) period.

Features:
- LRU eviction policy: when the cache reaches its maximum capacity,
  the least recently accessed item is evicted.
- TTL expiry: each entry carries an expiry timestamp; expired items are
  removed lazily on access or during explicit cleanup.
- Thread safety: the cache is protected by a reentrant lock (threading.Lock)
  so that concurrent reads and writes are safe.
- Pytest suite: a comprehensive suite of unit tests covering basic
  functionality, LRU eviction, TTL expiry, thread safety, and edge cases.

The design is intentionally self-contained so that the entire module can
be dropped into a project and run as-is with pytest.
"""

import threading
import time
from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Callable


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core LRU Cache Implementation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _TTLEntry:
    """
    Internal representation of a single cache entry.

    Stores the value, the time of insertion, the time of last access,
    and the absolute expiry time (insertion time + TTL).

    Attributes:
        value: The cached payload.
        inserted_at: Time (unix timestamp) when the entry was inserted.
        accessed_at: Time (unix timestamp) when the entry was last accessed.
        expires_at: Time (unix timestamp) when the entry should be expired.
    """

    __slots__ = ("value", "inserted_at", "accessed_at", "expires_at")

    def __init__(self, value: Any, inserted_at: float, expires_at: float):
        self.value = value
        self.inserted_at = inserted_at
        self.accessed_at = inserted_at
        self.expires_at = expires_at
